recommendation: Keep this source commit. It restores the durable Documentation Index link requested by FHIR-8438 while respecting later THO migration decisions and avoiding unresolved FHIR-53786 wording changes.
issue_request: FHIR-8438 was Published/Persuasive for DSTU1 and asked that identifier systems be findable directly from the Documentation page or Systems navigation, rather than only through a non-obvious data types page link.
initial_application: The issue was applied in svn revision 5912, imported as git commit 406f6e71752058c23aeabbdd9e0eff46c168d41f, which added Identifier Registry to source/documentation.html and cross-linked source/terminologies-systems.html and source/identifier-registry.html. The 2017 Documentation Index reorganization in ec7f976bd4e36e78630215dc696bc718b516b0ab later dropped the Identifier Registry item while simplifying the Terminologies links.
additional_context: source/hierarchy.xml keeps identifier-registry.html in current build navigation, and source/identifier-registry.html now points to HL7 Terminology for actively curated identifier systems after FHIR-35932. FHIR-37853 later removed the Code Systems page identifier-systems statement because THO became the source of truth, so that cross-reference was not reintroduced. FHIR-53786 is an unresolved R6 proposal to rename/reword the page and was treated as background only.
reconciliation: Added a Known Identifier Systems link under the Documentation Index Terminologies subsection in source/documentation.html, using the same informative flag pattern as the adjacent Code Systems and Value Sets links.
source_changes: source/documentation.html:39 adds a Known Identifier Systems link under Documentation Index > Terminologies.

related_jiras.note: Migrated the identifier registry content to HL7 Terminology while retaining the core identifier-registry page as the current navigation target.

Unresolved R6 proposal to rename/reword the identifier systems page; not final and not applied.
